items.title: John Budd interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997 [transcript only]
items.q: I’ve known Bob Haggart for 40 years. I knew him and his wife as a fan and becoming a friend.

ctx.x: Chautauqua party. The emotional minute of that thing was the last time when the big band played and the closing thing was Bob Haggart’s “South Rampart Street Parade.” And they played that, I could just cry that was so good. I’ve known Bob Haggart for 40 years. I knew him and his wife as a fan and becoming a friend. And I can never forget the way they played that one piece. It just dissolved me nearly. And he’s a remarkable person.
I think it’s so neat because it’s almost like if you were living in Beethoven’s time being able to actually hear Beethoven play.
